Spacious accommodations, advanced technology and an impressive road presence unite in the commanding 2026 Genesis GV80.
With a truly pure black interior and your choice of a fully black or white exterior, Prestige Black is a special new trim level only available on GV80 Coupe, GV80, G80 and G90.
The Genesis Neolun Concept, meaning 'The New Moon,' embodies humanity's longstanding fascination with the moon.
In a world rapidly transforming, Genesis is choosing to shape its own path and define what comes next through technology, design, and imagination.
The Neolun Concept embodies the best of our thinking and is the most refined expression of our collective vision.
Stay connected for the latest Neolun Concept news and developments.
The Genesis Neolun Concept incorporates the best of Korean minimalist aesthetics to create an ultraluxe vision of what an SUV can be.
The iconic two-line design seamlessly embraces the body from the headlights to the tail lamps and evoke a sense of haute couture craftsmanship.
Welcome to bespoke comfort, designed entirely around you.

The unmistakable B-Pillarless Coach Doors not only reveal an expansive interior outfitted with warm cashmere, matte leather and real wood, they reveal 180-degree swivel seats and the Genesis Son-nim philosophy of welcoming our passengers as honored guests.
Strategically placed speakers have been sonically designed and meticulously tuned to create a three-dimensional concert hall audio experience.
Inspired by traditional Korean underfloor heating, this warming system enhances heat efficiency while providing a luxurious lounge-like experience.
Seamlessly integrating into the dashboard, the Adjustable Display can move vertically for optimal navigation functionality.
A Rotating Column Type Shift-by-Wire has been integrated into the steering wheel.
By merging the two, the connected interface prioritizes safety while offering superior aesthetics.
The Neolun Concept seamlessly weaves tomorrow’s cutting-edge technology into every refined detail.
Where innovation blends with visionary design, this is the future of driving reimagined without limits or hesitation.
